content: Common hobby trading bot anti-features: (1) Beautiful dashboard/web UI — weekly cadence needs email report not React frontend; (2) Real-time streaming data — -500/month cost, not needed for weekly bot; (3) Full backtesting framework — takes months to build, trust academic literature and forward-test; (4) ML models — overfitting machine with small datasets under 10k examples; (5) Multiple simultaneous strategies — can't attribute what's working. Overfitting traps: over-parameterized signal thresholds each fit to historical data, look-ahead bias from using transaction date vs filing date, survivorship bias from static universe vs dynamic S&P 500 membership, chasing signal decay by refitting parameters, ignoring spread costs in analysis.
